newsitem.title: USA: ADR REPORT - Argentina's YPF rises in NY.
newsitem.headline: ADR REPORT - Argentina's YPF rises in NY.

text.p: Shares in Argentine oil company YPF SA rose near a year high on Tuesday as foreign stocks were boosted by a rising overall market, traders said.
"The Dow went up 80 points yesterday and is pulling people along. That's pretty clear today," one trader said. The Dow Jones Industrial Average was up 29 points at midday.
American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) in YPF rose 1/8 to 23-7/8, just short of a 12-month high of 24-1/4. Volume was 1.3 million shares, well above its average daily volume.
"All the oils have been strong and this one has sort of lagged," another trader said. "That's what some people are looking for -- laggards."
He said investors had begun to switch out of larger higher-priced stocks as they sought relatively higher value in less well-known companies.
Among European stocks, Swedish telecommunications company LM Ericsson rose 1/2 to 30-1/8 after Standard & Poor's raised the company's credit outlook to positive from stable.

Canada's Arakis Energy Corp fell 9/16 to 4-1/2 after reports on Monday that gunfire briefly halted operations at its $1 billion oil project in Sudan. Volume was 4.2 million shares, more than twice its daily average.

Another Canadian company, Potash Corp of Saskatchewan Inc, rose 4-3/8 to 86-1/2 after it bought a controlling stake in Germany's Kali und Salz Beteiligungs AG, a unit of German chemicals group BASF AG.
Advancers led decliners by a margin of 302 to 217 among 807 ADRs. Volume was 40.8 million shares.
